output.population: Patients who underwent tracked prostate biopsy sessions using the Artemis biopsy system, most with MRI-ultrasound fusion targeting and systematic 12-core template sampling.
output.summary: Tracked prostate biopsy sessions fusing real-time transrectal ultrasound with preoperative multiparametric MRI. Targeted and systematic core locations were recorded relative to the ultrasound, with MRI biopsy coordinates and T2-weighted images provided.
